code_facts_treatment: Author predicates and separate independent code refutation, not newly proven by this specification pass.
overall: Retain all three normative cores; narrow F01 to durability evidence and F03 to lost eventual cleanup obligation. No independent claim of executed Android failure.

findings.specification_core: VERIFIED includes durable READY and directories; file/parent synchronization failures must be reported; rename alone does not establish power-loss durability.
findings.source_gap_predicate: Independent code review finds necessary directory durability operations missing and no equivalent guarantee.
findings.reachable_impact_predicate: Power loss on a filesystem without stronger implicit durability can lose an unsynchronized name/link.
refutations_considered: Same-volume rename provides publication atomicity but not automatically durable parent/nested metadata
File hash/fd sync does not by itself fulfill the named directory durability obligation
Later repair detection cannot substitute for pre-publication durability
Specification does not mandate one particular helper call sequence or a fsync on every directory if an equivalent proven mechanism exists
allowed_alternatives: Any design proving necessary names and parent links durable before the corresponding durable phase
findings.narrowing: Do not claim observed target-device loss or insist bottom-up per-directory fsync is the only conforming implementation.
findings.verification_only: Target filesystem directory/power-loss behavior and effective durability of the complete candidate.

findings.specification_core: Incomplete/inconsistent candidates must reconcile to completion, rollback or a controlled recover/repair state; valid unblocked older versions remain usable on update failure.
findings.source_gap_predicate: A bad journal repeatedly aborts initialization without a product-controlled way to finish/rollback/repair, withholding otherwise valid versions globally.
findings.reachable_impact_predicate: Independently established interrupted install or same-release full-package repair boundary reaches that non-converging state.
findings.coordinator_code_update: Separate code refutation reported a stronger same-release repair -> VERIFIED -> process death path; this specification pass confirms repair/boundary scope without redoing its code audit.
refutations_considered: Pending recovery and temporary conservative startup gating are allowed
A recoverable maintenance flow with actual completion/rollback/repair is acceptable
No unconditional automatic rollback into a damaged/incompatible old release is required
No startup full-resource hash is required
Retaining old files physically does not satisfy availability if a recoverable bad candidate blocks all valid releases indefinitely
allowed_alternatives: Per-candidate isolation/quarantine with durable recovery status
Verified restoration of a valid previous-active reference
findings.narrowing: The violation is non-converging global denial for an otherwise recoverable candidate, not the presence of a one-time exception or temporary ready gate.
findings.verification_only: Fault-boundary recovery, UI repair path and preserved valid-library availability.

findings.specification_core: DB activation can precede cleanup, but CLEANED means unreferenced download/temporary data is actually removed and the operation ends idempotently.
findings.source_gap_predicate: Archive/index temporaries are unreferenced, CLEANED/terminal ownership is discarded, and no durable/reconstructible cleaner takes responsibility.
findings.reachable_impact_predicate: Successful recovery or interruption after terminal transfer state leaves large archives indefinitely, potentially accumulating enough space to obstruct later installs.
refutations_considered: Immediate activation-time deletion is explicitly not required
An independent durable cleanup job or reconstructible owner ledger can satisfy the rule after journal removal
Legitimately referenced retained files are not automatically garbage
A phase name or DB deletion is insufficient evidence of actual cleanup
findings.narrowing: Report the permanent lost cleanup obligation, not the mere presence of the archive just after activation; exact deletion mechanism is not mandated.
findings.verification_only: Recovered/failed cleanup replay, reference checks, actual residual byte counts and eventual reclamation.

exclusions_confirmed: Conservative retention without automatic old-version GC satisfies the no-premature-GC restriction
Missing positive health/rollback transitions belong to adjacent UPD scope and are not counted as early-GC defects
Safe commit sections may defer cancellation; instantaneous cancellation is not an added requirement
No new schema-field finding is authored by this specification pass
